ledger.claim: Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass on this trip's own evidence. The governing distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 4.08 km on EV-GPS-00801, and the platform's booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-00801 is 3.15 km, so the measured excess is 0.93 km — 29.5% of optimal. That clears the 20% threshold and, at 0.93 km, also clears the 0.8 km absolute threshold; neither limb is marginal, and POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern over the rounded convenience copy on the trip record in any event.

The refund under POL-RD-02 is arithmetic, and it is SGD 1.45. Read on the FARE_BREAKDOWN EV-FARE-00801: charged_total 11.63, surge_multiplier 1.15 (read from the fare breakdown, which is the only artifact that carries it), promo_discount 0.60, waiting_time_fee 0.00, no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge. Recomputed fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15) + 0.80 - 0.60 = 10.184875. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, which is above the 0.50 de minimis, and the payable figure rounded UP to the nearest 0.05 is 1.45. The refund is 12.4% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the correct outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.45 and not a refund of the whole 11.63 the claim invites the tribunal to review.

Nothing in the bundle exonerates the excess under POL-RD-03. EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with no payload — so there is no advisory naming a closed road or segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window and no shortest_lawful_alternative_km to run the clause on. I disclose the impairment and rely on the absence itself, which is citable: under POL-RD-13 POL-RD-03 is unavailable, any assertion of an external traffic cause cannot be tested and carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and the excess stands at the measured 0.93 km against the booked optimal of 3.15 km. There is in any event no counterparty statement on this file (the trip record's platform_policy is null and EV-CHAT-00801 is empty).

The chat log closes the POL-RD-04 route: EV-CHAT-00801 records message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at both null and truncated false, so there is no rider instruction, no named road and no chat_message.waypoint_hint that could be tested against the 200 m corroboration rule. No distance driven on this trip is attributable to a rider-requested detour and POL-RD-04 excludes nothing from the excess.

No endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the baseline stays where POL-RD-01 puts it. EV-TRIP-00801 carries pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null; there is no amendment timestamp, no re-quote, and no evidence of circling within 400 m of an amended point to exclude. The record's vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply either and the booked optimal of 3.15 km is the correct comparator.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. EV-GPS-00801 carries 67 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval, coverage_pct 100.0, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec 10 — far inside the 90 second gap limb and the 30 second sustained-interval limb. Because no limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, the excess need not be corroborated by an independent source, POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged, and under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the figure measured on the trace.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden and nothing has been cited to shift it back. EV-TRIP-00801, EV-GPS-00801 and EV-FARE-00801 all carry trip TRP-00801, and the fare breakdown's stored optimal_distance_km (3.15) and optimal_duration_min (9.0) are the same figures the trip record holds, so the artifacts describe the same trip; the excess of 0.93 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden then lies on the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause, and there is no counterparty statement, no chat message and no advisory in the bundle for him to point to. The rider's own profile does not raise the corroboration bar: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far below the four-claims-and-one-substantiated trigger.

This is a metered trip, so the distance remedy is open and no pass-through correction can enlarge or displace it. EV-FARE-00801 records fare_model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. Equally, POL-RD-09 adds nothing here: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, no airport surcharge is charged, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport — so there is no billing-integrity defect and no off-route pass-through, and the 1.45 figure is the whole of the money the rider recovers on the fare.

The rider is presently carrying the disputed charge in full: EV-FARE-00801 shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 against a charged_total of 11.63. Under POL-GEN-03 a PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.45 returns to the filing rider the part of the contested amount that was never earned, leaving the rider not carrying the charge for the 0.93 km driven beyond the platform's own optimal route.

The measured excess on this trip is 0.93 km, or 29.5% of the 3.15 km booking optimal (EV-GPS-00801, derived.deviation). That clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate — greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20% — but it is nowhere near the 8.0 km or 50% figures the same clause sets for a MATERIAL deviation. This is therefore a non-material overrun, and the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check, with the full-refund uplift it licenses, is not engaged on this trip.

On the only profile fields POL-RD-06 permits to be used (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d), the driver records 0 trailing-90-day deviation flags over 300 completed trips (EV-DPROF-00801). Neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test is met: 0 is below 3, and 0/300 = 0.000 is below 0.05 with well over the 40 completed trips required. No repeat-deviation pattern can be established, so the POL-RD-06(b) full refund is unavailable and there is no footing for a POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. No other profile field may be used for this test under POL-GEN-01.

The fare is METERED, so the rider's request to 'review the whole fare' of SGD 11.63 has no policy footing: POL-RD-02 measures the remedy as charged_total less a fare recomputed on the optimal route, not the whole fare. With the 1.15 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown, recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP - 0.60 promo = 10.184875, giving a refund of 1.445125, rounded up to SGD 1.45. The exposure on this trip is that figure, not the 11.63 the rider asks the tribunal to review.

Nothing may be layered on top of that figure. The ERP lines on EV-FARE-00801 total 0.00 both on and off the optimal route, there is no airport surcharge line and no gantry the trace never crosses, and under POL-RD-09(1) any off-route ERP would already be comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund rather than added to it. POL-RD-09 therefore contributes no further amount here.

The distance fig is a measured rather than an extrapolated one: the trace carries 67 fixes at the 10-second expected interval with 100% coverage, no gaps and a 10-second maximum gap (EV-GPS-00801). There is no broken stretch to reason across and no basis in the record from which an overrun larger than the measured 0.93 km could be inferred, so the case should be disposed of on the measured figure.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties' core submissions are accepted. The trip is TRP-00801 throughout EV-TRIP-00801, EV-GPS-00801 and EV-FARE-00801. On EV-GPS-00801 the governing trace distance is 4.08 km, with 67 fixes, 100% coverage, max gap 10 seconds and 10-second sampling; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). The booked optimal on EV-TRIP-00801 is 3.15 km, so the excess is 0.93 km, or 29.5% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass: greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km. The deviation is not material (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged; in any event EV-DPROF-00801 shows 0 deviation_flags_90d over 300 completed_trips_90d, so no repeat pattern, no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) referral. The fare is METERED on EV-FARE-00801, so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not apply. Using the fare-breakdown surge_multiplier 1.15, charged_total 11.63, optimal distance 3.15 km, optimal duration 9.0 min, platform fee 0.80, promo discount 0.60, and zero ERP, tolls, waiting time and surcharges: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15) + 0.80 - 0.60 = 10.184875. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, rounded UP to SGD 1.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: ERP lines are 0.00, there is no airport surcharge, and there is no unmatched gantry or billing-integrity referral. POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 excuse no excess: EV-CHAT-00801 is empty, no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded, and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence means POL-RD-03 cannot exonerate the deviation, and it does not carry the deciding fact or reduce confidence. No counterparty statement is on file. The rider's request to review the whole SGD 11.63 is not granted as a full refund; the policy formula returns the partial amount of SGD 1.45. The monetary effect is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it is executable automatically unless appealed. Confidence is 0.95, within the 1.0 weights of the GPS trace, trip record and fare breakdown that carry the deciding facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
